wolfSSL
Copyright wolfSSL Inc. and contributors.
Distributed under GPL version 3; see upstream COPYING.
The official build clones the latest stable official Git tag only when
third_party/wolfssl/local is absent. Existing local source is reused offline
without fetching, pulling or resetting developer changes.
Dependency source remains local and is excluded from repository commits.
Static build cache and selected Git revision records remain under out/deps.
The dependency checkout supplies COPYING for the artifact license step.
Build settings: source/tcard/build/sync-dependencies.ps1.
Upstream releases: https://github.com/wolfSSL/wolfssl/releases/latest
TLS 1.3 PSK documentation: https://www.wolfssl.com/documentation/manuals/wolfssl/group__Setup.html
